A host state changed a regulatory framework the investor had relied on, though the change applied equally to every domestic and foreign competitor alike.
A tribunal held that a change applying equally to all competitors did not, by itself, breach the fair-and-equitable-treatment standard.
quests.hint: Notice precisely what the tribunal's ruling requires beyond a mere disruption of expectations.
quests.explanation: Because the tribunal holds an equally applied change does not by itself breach the standard, an option claiming any disruption automatically breaches it contradicts that carefully qualified ruling.
